name: Izumi Takahira
source:
Takahira is (supposedly) a staff member of the rival inn "Kiyominekaku".

He is often seen hanging around Fukujurou... too often to the point that some question whether he's actually working there or not. He claims that he just took a liking to Fukujurou, but it that really true?
